scope: Locate phase-gradient trajectory drift before changing kernels; diagnostics do not replace frozen qualification gates.

design.all_37_parameter_tensors: At the state before update 12, replace one runtime tensor by its frozen-reference value, and inject one runtime tensor into the reference state; evaluate each hybrid in CPU f64 to separate weight-state sensitivity from f32 evaluator noise.
design.same_state: CPU f32 and f64 at every recorded runtime pre-update state; CPU f32 at every frozen reference state must reproduce the frozen phase VJP exactly.
design.update_residual: Predict every next parameter using CPU-f32 gradients at the exact runtime state; compare with recorded next runtime values. This combines backend-gradient and update rounding differences; it is not a proof that SGD is wrong.

boundaries: No threshold changes, fixture regeneration or runtime changes in this diagnosis.
Retain every case and every tensor attribution, not only favorable rows.
Raw vectors remain local. Public results may include scalars, hashes and reproduction instructions.
